scope: Portable CLI install, offline execution, candidate corruption rejection, atomic upgrade, rollback and uninstall on an isolated macOS host. This is engineering evidence, not public beta publication or formal Issue #5 acceptance.

test.name: rehearses verified upgrade, rollback, offline execution and uninstall

probes.name: offline install execution
probes.expected: The stable current link runs a scan with unusable proxy endpoints and no dependency installation.
probes.observed: passed; exit 0 and the unscoped dependency remained unknown

probes.name: candidate integrity rejection
probes.expected: A modified candidate fails provenance before the current link changes.
probes.observed: passed; exit 1 with a dist/index.js checksum mismatch and current still pointed to first

probes.name: atomic upgrade and rollback
probes.expected: Verified release switching and rollback use a staged link rename and continue to scan successfully.

probes.name: uninstall
probes.expected: Removing current and release directories leaves the installation parent intact.

limitations: The test is authored lifecycle regression evidence and does not establish public beta acceptance.
The test uses an isolated local macOS directory and does not replace a clean independent-host rehearsal.
A real authorized project walkthrough and product-owner acceptance remain required before Issue #5 can close.
Registry or marketplace publication, signing, distribution authorization and rollback by a release owner remain gated.
